lesson: The system consistently attempted to catch 'longs' during Wyckoff distribution phases and blow-off tops, ignoring clear bearish structural breakdowns on the 1h and 4h timeframes. By prioritizing higher-timeframe bullish bias over immediate price action, the model failed to recognize that ZEC was actively rejecting resistance zones.
adjustment: Implement a hard filter that prohibits long entries if the 4h timeframe shows a breakdown of market structure or RSI divergence, regardless of the daily trend.
methodology_flag: Trust lower-timeframe Wyckoff distribution signals more than higher-timeframe bullish bias when ZEC is extended.
